About AI, Actually

A weekly publication for people who are curious about AI but uneasy about its direction.

We round up credible good news about AI and the outcomes it helps people achieve. Occasional explainers examine contentious topics, including their real costs and unresolved questions.

Our goal is to help you feel more hopeful and better informed. We prioritize benefits to people over funding rounds and hype.

Questions or corrections? Email the editor.
